english.title: Receive scrap metal in the course of business fail to record s.13(2) information - site manager
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) you were the site manager of **(..SPECIFY SITE..) when **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a scrap metal dealer, failed to record the information required under section 13(2) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE INFORMATION THAT WAS NOT RECORDED..), having received scrap metal at that site in the course of the dealer's business
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(1) and (2) and 15(4) and (6) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.

english.notes: It is a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that they made arrangements to ensure that the requirement was fulfilled and took all reasonable steps to ensure that those arrangements were complied with.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant was the site manager of **(..SPECIFY SITE..) when **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a scrap metal dealer, failed to record the information required under section 13(2) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE INFORMATION THAT WAS NOT RECORDED..), having received scrap metal at that site in the course of the dealer's business.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
